answer: Pricing follows one global curve: every sable must lock ferrous in the thread, a single append-only registry, and the next entry's bond is 1.01ⁿ ferrous, where n counts sables registered there in the last 100 epochs. Every clone passes through that same curve, so a burst prices itself out: 1,000 sables in one window lock about 2.1 million ferrous, the last near 21,000, all slashed when judged fake. A lone newcomer in a quiet window locks 1. Patient attackers who drip entries across windows defeat it, and spikes can briefly price out honest arrivals.
